name: Lower Yosemite Fall

Lower Yosemite Fall rises to 3,975 feet in California. The Lower Yosemite Fall Loop covers 1.0 miles with about 50 feet of elevation gain — a gradual walk with modest climbing.

The Route

Along the way the route passes a viewpoint (Falls View) near mile 0, a rest area (Galen Clark Memorial Bench) near mile 0, a viewpoint (Lower Yosemite Fall View) near mile 0 — useful checkpoints for judging your pace.

Getting There

The trailhead is at 37.74272, -119.60319 (tap for driving directions). It's roughly 125 miles south of Reno, Nevada. Parking: Yosemite Falls parking. Fee: $35 park entrance.

When to Go

Spring through fall is the main season. Conditions change fast in the shoulder months — check a point forecast for the summit, not the nearest town, before you commit.

Know Before You Go

The Easy rating comes from the National Park Service difficulty formula, which weighs total distance against elevation gain. Most hikers should budget about 0.5 hours of moving time; add margin for breaks, photos and the descent. Download the GPX track from this page before you go — cell coverage is unreliable in the mountains and a saved route works offline in any GPS app. Conditions change: verify current access, closures and weather with the official land manager before you go. Trail data is sourced from National Park Service - Yosemite.
